<thought>To find the appropriate retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog using the forward‑reaction criteria described for the Peterson reaction: the forward reaction breaks a ketone and a trimethylsilyl group, forms a C‑C double bond, and breaks C‑Si and C‑O bonds while forming a C=C bond. This should return the template that can be applied retrosynthetically to the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "trimethylsilyl"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-Si", "C-O"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C=C"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
